items.title: Anthropic reportedly must face claims its Claude Max ads misled users
items.summary:
A US judge has ruled that Anthropic must face key claims that it misled customers about how much use they get from its Claude Max plans. Magistrate Judge Alex Tse dismissed several other claims on Friday, Courthouse News reported. The proposed class action, Kahn v. Anthropic, is in the federal court for northern California. items.title: Companies Are Spending 5x More on AI Now
items.summary: Markets just had their worst day since 2020 and the Anthropic IPO is wobbling, but Menlo's latest State of Enterprise AI report tells a different story: business AI spend is accelerating from a bigger base, and agents are the reason. Budgets built for seats are colliding with a per-token reality.
